content.comment_body: Hello everyone, Which communication protocols does the Ethernet port on the [product_name] support? Also, is it possible to use [product_name] with [product_name] V13 and V7.3 without major issues or limitations?

From what I know, the [product_name] [article_no] can work with [product_name] TIA Portal (V11 or newer) as well as [product_name] flexible. Regarding [product_name] V7.3, to my knowledge it is not supported. There are examples from [company_name], see this link: [url]

Thank you for the quick answer. However, my focus is on which protocols are supported by the Ethernet port. My project needs to connect the [product_name] to a Building Management System, so I want to find out which shared protocols are available.

Hello, The [product_name] supports S7 protocol over TCP/IP. You can connect [product_name] to a KNX bus using the relevant expansion module. For SCADA systems, an OPC server (such as [product_name]) is needed, as most SCADA software does not include native drivers for this product. Other communications are possible using gateways or similar devices via the Internet. Hope this information is useful.
You asked not only about protocols, but also about whether the [product_name] can communicate with [product_name] V7.3 or [product_name] TIA Portal. I answered this compatibility question previously.

Hi, I'm not knowledgeable about the latest versions of [product_name] OPC server, specifically whether a [product_name] communication driver exists. If there's no dedicated driver, the S7-200 communication driver can be used as an alternative. In that setup, you can only directly access certain basic addresses. Full access is still possible but requires using VM memory mapping. This is similar to S7-200, where only DB1 is directly accessible for [product_name]. Hope this clarifies things.
Which protocols does the [product_name] support for external controllers? Please provide a list. Does it support data logging? Can you confirm if NTP time server support is included?
Hello [user_name], Welcome to the forum. Is this a question or just a test post?

Are you referring to an NTP time server? If so, [product_name] version 8.1 with FS4 or newer, and the current 8.2, support NTP time server functionality. These [product_name] models support Ethernet TCP/IP and Modbus TCP/IP through the S7 protocol.
